entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold forever! I want to return something and I want to do it NOW.

Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, and I'm with VeloFit support. I'm sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. I can definitely help you with a return. Could I please get your name and order number to start?
It's David Chen. Order number 94-Alpha-72. This whole process is a joke. I have a jersey here that I need to send back. It's completely useless to me.

Okay, David, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the ClubFit Jersey purchased a couple of months ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

A preference? It's the wrong size! It's so tight I can barely breathe in it. This is your company's fault. If you don't fix this immediately, I'm going to leave a one-star review on every website I can find. Now, are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, David, and there's no need to speak to a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. So the issue is that the jersey is too tight and you need a different size. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
You'd better. I'm not paying for a product I can't even wear. I want an exchange or my money back.
Of course. One moment... Okay, I've checked the policy. I see the delivery was 78 days ago, and our standard apparel has a 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe to send it back.
So... you're actually going to approve it? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this for you right now. We can either do an exchange for a larger size, or I can set up a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. Which would you prefer?
Oh. Uh, a refund then. A full refund. That would be fine.

Perfect. I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as it's scanned at our warehouse.
Okay. Well... thank you. I appreciate you sorting that out.
You're very welcome, David. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
